plugins.description: Analyse PDF bank and credit card statements from any bank worldwide (HDFC, Kotak, Barclays, Chase, CommBank, and more). Automatically extracts transactions, categorises spending into 18 categories, detects currency, and generates a formatted Excel report with charts, monthly trends, top merchants, and a budget planner.
